name: SUNBURN ~Idol to Survival Mujintou to Iu Misshitsu~
original_name: サンバーン ～アイドルとサバイバル無人島という密室～
source:
On the way from Sydney to Hong Kong, the plane carrying main character crashes. He finds himself on an inhabited island with idols and just cute girls. They need to survive together till help arrives. Protagonist gets to know a secret about one of the girls, and she's ready for anything to keep it secret.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角搭乘的飞机从悉尼飞往香港途中坠毁。他与几名偶像和可爱少女流落荒岛，必须共同求生，等待救援。主角偶然得知其中一名少女的秘密，而为了守住秘密，她什么都愿意做。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
